correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated every admissible directed-arc subset on bidirected K2,n (indegree/outdegree≤1, no directed cycle). For n=4,5 face vectors (16,80,144,72), (20,130,320,240). Independently constructed full signed integer boundaries, ∂²=0, Smith d1=(1^15),(1^19), d2=(1^65),(1^111), d3=(1^71,2),(1^208,2); rational ranks (15,65,72) and (19,111,209), binary ranks (15,65,71) and (19,111,208). Hence exact H2 free ranks 7,0 with one Z/2 each, H3 free ranks 0,31 and no further reduced homology. Coker∂3 torsion equals H2 torsion as quotient is free im∂2. Every arc of a dynamical region forces its reverse via digon, making endpoints unstable; neither can be boundary, forcing all incident arcs and hence all of connected D_n. The full D_n is a nonstable dynamical module, as defined in the cited 2024 primary article.
